payload.text:
Act as an expert web developer. Create a "House Rent Calculator & Receipt" web application for me using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I want all the code in a single index.html file.
Key Requirements:
UI Language: The interface labels must be in English.
Input Fields: Create a clean form to input:
Tenant Name (ভাড়াটিয়ার নাম) - Text Field
Rent Month (কোন মাসের ভাড়া) - Dropdown (January-December) or Text
Payment Date (প্রদানের তারিখ) - Date Picker
House Rent (বাসা ভাড়া)
Gas Bill (গ্যাস বিল)
Electricity Bill (বিদ্যুৎ বিল)
WiFi Bill (wifi বিল)
Garbage Bill (ময়লার বিল)
Previous Due (পূর্বের বাকি)
Paid Amount/Deposit (জমা)
Functionality:
A "Calculate" button to generate the result.
Total Bill (সর্বমোট): Sum of Rent, Gas, Electricity, WiFi, Garbage, and Previous Due.
Remaining Due (বাকি): Calculate (Total Bill - Paid Amount).
Display / Receipt Section:
After clicking Calculate, show a designed "Rent Receipt" card below.
The receipt must display the Tenant Name, Date, and Month at the top.
Show the breakdown of all bills, the Total Amount, Paid Amount, and Remaining Due clearly.
Extra Feature: Add a "Print Receipt" button that lets me print or save the receipt area as a PDF.
Design: Modern, clean, and mobile-friendly.

import React from 'react'; import { CalculationResult, LandlordInfo } from '../types'; interface ReceiptCardProps { data: CalculationResult; landlord: LandlordInfo; flatNo: string; } export const ReceiptCard: React.FC = ({ data, landlord, flatNo }) => { const formatCurrency = (val: number) => { return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-BD', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BDT' }).format(val).replace('BDT', '৳'); }; const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => { if (!dateStr) return ''; const [year, month, day] = dateStr.split('-'); return `${day}-${month}-${year}`; }; const rows = [ { label: 'Basic House Rent', value: data.houseRent }, { label: 'Gas Utility Bill', value: data.gasBill }, { label: 'Electricity Bill', value: data.electricityBill }, { label: 'WiFi / Internet Service', value: data.wifiBill }, { label: 'Waste Management (Garbage)', value: data.garbageBill }, { label: 'Previous Arrears / Due', value: data.previousDue }, ]; return (
{/* Header */}

{landlord.houseName}

Residential Complex

Location: House {landlord.houseNo}, Shahzadpur

Proprietor: {landlord.name}

Mobile: {landlord.mobile}

MEMO # {Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}

Digital Invoice

{/* Info Grid */}

Bill To Tenant

{data.tenantName}

Unit: {flatNo}

Billing Schedule

{data.rentMonth}

Issued: {formatDate(data.paymentDate)}

{/* Table */} {rows.map((row, idx) => ( ))}
Description Amount
{row.label} {formatCurrency(row.value)}
Gross Total Payable {formatCurrency(data.totalBill)}
Payment Deposited (-) {formatCurrency(data.paidAmount)}
Net Outstanding Balance {formatCurrency(data.remainingDue)}
{/* Footer Signatures */}

Tenant Signature

Manager / Landlord

Thank you for being our valued resident
); };
